text:
Type: ribbed ceramic table lamp
Use: accent and bedside light; bedroom, living room, home office; on a nightstand, side table or shelf
Style: contemporary, rustic, coastal
Materials: reactive-glazed ceramic base with textured ribbing, linen-look fabric shade
Colors: dark navy blue, warm brown flecks, white
Shape: slim bottle-shaped base with horizontal textured bands, tall cylindrical drum shade, compact
Feel: earthy, cozy, crafted
Goes with: natural wood, white or cream walls, blue textiles; farmhouse, coastal or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Glazed Ceramic Table Lamp, 19"H, Dark Blue
product.description: This ceramic lamp's textured pattern with a glossy dark-blue glazed finish has a true classic look that will add a touch of sophistication to any room. 9"W x 9"D x 19"H Dark-blue textured reactive glazed ceramic base; brushed-nickel accents; off-white linen drum shade This bold ceramic lamp is paired with an off-white linen drum shade to cast perfect ambient light. Includes 1 60-watt equivalent LED bulb included
